issue: Logs the full WS URI including ?token=<clash_api_secret> (32-hex bearer) into vpnrouter*.log on every connect/reconnect; CrashReporter.ScrubSecrets does not match ws:// URLs or 32-char hex tokens, so the secret survives verbatim into crash reports shared with support
fix: Log only the authority+path (e.g. _logsUri.GetLeftPart(UriPartial.Path)) or redact the query; alternatively add ws:// to _proxyUriPattern or extend ScrubSecrets with the _logKeyValueSecret pass so crash reports scrub token= values

issue: File.ReadAllLines reads the entire daily log into memory with no byte cap; a busy day (sing-box process-path spam can produce hundreds of MB) OOMs the crash handler and silently loses the report — the same pattern was already fixed in DiagnosticsExporter.TailLines (MaxTailReadBytes seek, pinned by DiagnosticsExporterTailBoundedTests)
fix: Replace File.ReadAllLines with a bounded tail read (seek to EOF − cap like DiagnosticsExporter.TailLines, or reuse that method) so only the last ~200 lines are materialised
